What is done: (1) submit (drive-phase.py submit) now files a wave member's strays in its executor return as `undeclaredPaths` (STRAYS_FIELD) and its did-line says the drive asks widen/discard/block after the member's gate, before its review. I put them in the filed return, not the drive state, because the drive state is shared by every member submitting at once and submit does not hold the drive's lock; the return belongs to the member alone and is written once. (2) New stray_step(ctx, state, task, executor) is called in advance() for a tree member after the gate block and before `if review_turn == "dispatch"`. It raises undeclared-change for the filed paths, leaving out paths now in task.files and paths the gated run's row names in followersOwed (new run_followers(ctx, run_id), which owed_followers now calls). The pending decision carries asked=STRAYS_ASKED. A `widen` answer is applied there through widen_task, so the reviewer reads the widened scope. (3) apply_answer copies `asked` into the undeclared mark. integrate_member, given an early word, runs integrate-task.py without --undeclared first and passes the word only when the verb's own question is a subset of the answered paths; otherwise it asks again. A small helper _integrate_run was extracted. (4) PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md submit paragraph rewritten to match.
